items.issue: The video infers an identifiable bride's sexual arousal, dissatisfaction and marriage motives from a public wedding-day post.
items.disposition: Do not present the inference as fact; keep it attributed to Mikey and exclude it from user-specific advice.

items.issue: Archived frames retain public usernames, faces, wedding images and comments involving people who did not participate in the guide project.
items.disposition: Keep in restricted research evidence; minimize or redact before any user-facing reproduction.

items.issue: The social-proof thesis is presented as a general female preference based on selected school, celebrity and wedding examples.
items.disposition: Keep as a tentative social-inference model and do not universalize by gender.

items.issue: Women are described as feeling-driven and genetically unable to prioritize facts.
items.disposition: Keep do_not_generalize; exclude biological essentialism from advice.

items.issue: The proposed 'excitement transfer' mechanism rests on a nightclub anecdote and may encourage exploiting arousal created in another context.
items.disposition: Do not use as a causal technique or shortcut around direct attraction and consent.

items.issue: The lover-provider binary reduces relationships to sexual access versus material support and predicts infidelity without evidence.
items.disposition: Keep do_not_generalize and do not diagnose couples with this framework.

items.issue: Claims that women seek superior genes elsewhere and have providers raise another man's child are unsupported and stigmatizing.
items.disposition: Exclude from factual and action-guidance use unless supported by relevant population evidence and individual facts.

items.issue: Mikey's condomless-sex and genetic-selection anecdote is an unverified self-report involving absent partners.
items.disposition: Do not use as evidence for women's motives, Mikey's status or a general sexual strategy.

items.issue: The husband's housing, bride-price, gold, sexual status and future marital risk are asserted without direct evidence.
items.disposition: Keep as unverified speculation and do not repeat as fact about the couple.

items.issue: The narrow condom-use statement is embedded in unsupported genetic and status claims.
items.disposition: If independently retained, separate the general safer-sex point from all partner-motive and genetic-preference claims.

items.issue: ASR may corrupt the public-post wording, names and sexual slang.
items.disposition: Check original audio and source post before exact quotation; current summary uses conservative paraphrase.
